migration_and_recovery_policy.v0100_auto_migration: When S_MAGIC != 'MP' or S_VERSION != 2, preserves legacy S_DRAGON_BITS ($F400..$F403), S_DRAGON_CNT ($F404 <= 32), S_PIPE_DISC ($F406 < 0x20), migrates S_LUIGI_MODE ($F407 & 1) -> S_CHAR_ID ($F405), zeroes $F408..$F41D, writes 'MP' + v2, and seals valid CRC16.
migration_and_recovery_policy.corruption_recovery: When S_MAGIC == 'MP' and S_VERSION == 2 but CRC16 mismatches, sanitizes S_CHAR_ID &= 3 and clamps S_DRAGON_CNT (zero if >32), then re-seals valid CRC16 without crashing.
